context: Settings is an in-memory key/value store. NewSettings() constructs it with a zero-value struct; Get and Has already work today since reading from a nil map is legal in Go.
explanation: NewSettings() never initializes the values field, so it stays a nil map. Get and Has happen to work because reading from a nil map returns the zero value, but the new Set method writes to it with s.values[key] = value, which panics with "assignment to entry in nil map" the first time it runs. Fix: initialize the map in NewSettings, e.g. return &Settings{values: make(map[string]string)}.
